scope: Qualitative source-image review, not annotated 3D ground truth. These findings do not modify inference or add frame-specific exclusions.

findings.finding: Held-out example: projected fingers extend farther and in a different spread than the visible curled fingers. The consistency pass does not establish the source finger pose.

Held-out example: a projected outer finger extends away from the visible hand outline during the grasp. The image does not support that extension despite the consistency pass; hidden finger contact remains unobservable.
Held-out example: projected extended fingertips run above the visible fingertips while the silhouette/depth tests pass. High mask recall does not establish correct finger length or placement.
Held-out example: projected open-hand fingertips overshoot the visible fingertips despite passing. Blur limits exact annotation, but the outline mismatch is visible.
Held-out example: the projected curled fingers extend visibly beyond the source finger outline despite passing. This is a visible shape/placement failure, not a measured 3D error.
Projected fingertips extend beyond the visible source fingers; numerical consistency does not establish correct finger placement.
Visible fingertip/outline mismatch despite a passing silhouette/depth score.
The mesh covers only part of the visible finger silhouette; passing partial overlap is insufficient for contact-target acceptance.
